implementation_completeness.rationale: Adds complete resident chat routing, document facts parsing, synthetic callback agenda with booking/cancellation transactions, plus matching unit and browser checks. Strong completeness; already at ceiling.

rubric_at_current_main.limit: Retained automated score on its recorded commit, not a fresh score of current main or a deployed-journey acceptance test.

methods.pull_metadata_command: gh api --paginate repos/jmservera/ama/pulls?state=all&per_page=100 --jq 'map({number,state,created_at,closed_at,merged_at,base:.base.ref}) | @json'; parse one JSON array per page
methods.documents: git show CURRENT_MAIN:PATH; whitespace tokenization; hashes are of original blob bytes
methods.log: Reuse anc/log_metrics.py entries() and HEDGE; counts exclude preamble and do not reconstruct earlier log versions.
methods.churn: Reuse anc/repo_history_metrics.py changes()/path_class() on pinned first-parent history, multi-parent plus PR-number-suffixed squash commits; UTC committer-date periods; binary deltas excluded.
limits: GitHub API retrieval spans an interval and is not an atomic historical snapshot.
Git commit dates and GitHub merge timestamps are different measurements.
Issue state counts do not measure delivered acceptance; open_issues_count mixes issues and pull requests.
Volume, churn, lexical matches and automated scores do not establish usability, decay or benefits.
No new live deployment journey, experiment, cost attribution or structural-complexity measurement.

boundary_reconciliation.explanation: The pinned Git commit timestamp is 16:19:38 UTC, but its PR445 integration is recorded by GitHub at 16:19:39 UTC. Counting through that integration reproduces the reported 183; the whole 15-24 October UTC calendar window contains 187. These are distinct cutoffs.
